to.name: online IANA protocol-parameter databases
to.revision: post-1994 online database formally recognized by RFC 3232

property: Periodic RFC snapshots of assigned Internet protocol parameters are replaced as the authoritative publication mechanism by continuously maintained online IANA databases.

date_or_range.notes: Online databases replaced the RFC series after 1994; RFC 3232 formally recorded/ratified this fact in 2002.

sources.supports: last major Assigned Numbers RFC snapshot / predecessor chain
formal obsolescence of RFC 1700 and replacement by online IANA database

negative_claims: This edge does not mean the assigned numbers themselves were renumbered when the publication medium changed.
It does not imply RFC 1700 remains reliable for current assignments; RFC 3232 explicitly warns it is incomplete and may be wrong.
open_questions: Reconstruct the complete 1977-1994 Assigned Numbers publication series and database workflow.
notes: Standards-infrastructure genealogy: publication and maintenance process changed while many numeric identities survived.
